notes.title: Music Remastery Patch
notes.notes:
All game tracks were remastered and some were replaced with new songs

Puzzles changed: 3-B, 6-1, 6-2, 9-1, 9-4, 9-B

Bug fixes

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
A game update was just published

- Slowed down the scrolling tiled background in the menu screen
- Fixed some UI layout issues
- A few bug and crash fixes
- Added arrow prompt indicator to the title screen
- Game is now Fullscreen by default (PC only)
- Changed Ad frequency (Mobile only)
- Altered many levels in worlds 1 and 2 to be easier
- Level 2-2 replaced
- Level 4-3 replaced
